description:
## Problem
`RecordingConnection` intercepts only `execute`, `cursor().execute` and `executescript` (`benchbox/core/tuning/applied_ledger.py:382-431`). Other driver methods pass through `__getattr__` unrecorded:
- Spark / PySpark / LakeSail / Velox use `.sql()`;
- BigQuery uses `.query()`;
- DataFusion uses `.sql()`.

Spark's tuned `PARTITIONED BY` / `CLUSTER BY` DDL does execute (`spark.py:617-658` → `run_spark_schema_creation_loop` → `spark.sql`), yet the status is `noop`.

Even once proxied, `is_schema_tuning_statement`'s footprint (`applied_ledger.py:119-123`, applied at `adapter.py:1555-1559`) lacks `partitioned by`, `clustered by`, `distkey`, `diststyle`, `duplicate key`, `primary index`, `distribution =`, `partitioning =`, `sorted_by` and `bucketed_by`. Statements with those clauses would still be filtered out (plan review F2).

## Change
- Adapters declare `ledger_execute_verbs`, e.g. `("sql",)` or `("query",)`, and the proxy wraps them.
- For BigQuery, record the job SQL and its final state.
- Extend the footprint with the keywords above, or better, renderer-tagged recording.
- Split multi-statement strings with `_split_sql_script` before recording. This closes the latent transient-prefix laundering path ("SET x; CREATE …" classified transient).

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Readbacks (SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE) through `.sql`/`.query` are not recorded.
- Capture never breaks a run.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
- This item touches paths listed in the soundness manifest by `tuning-trust-paths-soundness-manifest-20261001`. The PR needs an external `Soundness review:` section (AGENTS.md) and must not auto-merge.
